QQQ.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (unofficial provider client)

interpretation.text:
QQQ’s 252-observation DFA H is 0.478 on 2026-11-11, below the ideal independent, finite-variance returns reference of 0.5. R²=0.956 describes fit quality only across the 12 supplied scales, spanning 8–63 observations. H fell 0.0183/0.0219 over 1/5 observations. Its prior-only, 30-estimate standardized deviation is +0.017; overlapping windows mean this is not a significance test.

The separate 1,000-observation Hill estimate is 3.380, using k=100 and x_min=0.02018 absolute log-return units. Conditional on a suitable tail model, lower alpha suggests heavier fitted absolute-return tails; higher suggests thinner tails. Using 5%/15% cutoffs gives 3.593/3.039: sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

H declined from 0.520 on 2026-11-06 to 0.478 on 2026-11-11; alpha rose from 3.300 to 3.380. These are uncertain descriptive estimates, not a crash forecast.
